article: Getting Started with Small LLM Inference in C++: TinyLlama, llama.cpp, and ggml
findings: Reframed the post as an introduction to maintained llama.cpp and its ggml foundation; removed unsupported promises that C++ is categorically faster, mmap is end-to-end zero-copy, or a from-scratch inference engine is delivered.

Replaced the invalid CMake fragment with the upstream Windows-compatible CMake build steps and corrected the multi-configuration CLI executable/model path. Clarified the model, license, chat-template, and quantization prerequisites.

Corrected GGUF alignment, Q4_0 versus Q4_K block sizes, TinyLlama parameter-memory estimates, GQA head configuration, allocation/KV-cache variability, and model-specific tokenizer guidance in all thirteen editions.
Compared the complete Japanese post with all twelve translations, including mathematical notation, section structure, code fences, internal/external links, metadata, and localized correction notes.
Preserved the 2026-09-11 publication date, added localized descriptions and lastmod 2026-11-23, and corrected the English title to reflect the actual article scope.

post/C++で始める小規模AIモデルの開発手順/index.en.md.source: post/C++で始める小規模AIモデルの開発手順/index.md

meaning.note: Compared the complete localized edition with Japanese, including scope, inference pipeline, model format, architecture, memory mapping, quantization, KV cache, tokenizer, build procedure, and conclusion.

terminology.note: Checked LLM, llama.cpp, ggml, GGUF, mmap, GQA, RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, Q4_0/Q4_K, KV cache, tokenizer, and localized technical wording across the editions.

mathematics.note: Compared the RMSNorm, RoPE, attention, SwiGLU, and quantization explanations and notation; added caveats for approximate parameter-memory estimates and the model-specific 32-query-head/4-KV-head configuration.

code.note: Removed the non-buildable source-file CMake skeleton and replaced it with official llama.cpp CMake commands and a corrected Windows CLI path. The commands were reviewed but not executed, and no custom inference engine is claimed.

links.note: Checked official llama.cpp build documentation, the ggml/llama.cpp project references, GGUF specification, TinyLlama model card/configuration, and translated internal links.
